assets.scope: Native player body family (paper-doll), not a class or NPC; identity key descriptor.subrace x descriptor.sex -> moddable_tile per overload/mod/class/CheckerPlayerTokens.lua. Covers birth subraces Higher and Cornac at sex=Male (both share this family and moddable_tile "human_#sex#"). Runtime id player-human-male, exported to data/gfx/tokens/player-human-male.png.

references.note: Approved style anchor: reuse its steep overhead three-quarter camera, matte painted miniature finish, thin charcoal-brown disc and bronze-grey bevel at exactly that lightness. Do not copy its crouching combat pose, bald head, daggers, leather vest or sash; this token is a calm standing figure in plain traveller's clothes with no weapon.

Native unequipped paper-doll base body (skin-tone option 1 of several cosmetic choices; any option is equally native). Establishes body proportions and base skin/fur/bone value only: a man of average build with rounded, uncovered ears. Ignore its flat front-facing T-pose, flat top light and total nudity; the token uses the style reference's camera, disc and pose instead, and the figure must be dressed per the brief.

prompt_fields.subject: One adult human man of unremarkable average build, standing in a calm neutral pose, weight even on both feet, arms relaxed at his sides with open hands. Short practical hair leaving his rounded ears fully visible and uncovered, a plain unweathered face with no beard or at most light stubble. Wears a simple long-sleeved tunic belted at the waist over plain trousers and soft low boots.
prompt_fields.contrast: Every other body family in this roster is judged against this human baseline: moderate five-to-six-head proportion, rounded ears, no unusual muscle mass or slenderness. Elf must read leaner and longer-limbed with pointed ear tips; dwarf must read shorter, stockier and bearded; halfling must read smaller again with a bigger, rounder head; ogre must read towering and heavily muscled. This figure must not be bald or scarred like the crouching style-reference bandit, and must not carry any of its equipment. Differs from the human_female token in this same set by a broader shoulder line, a straighter waist-to-hip taper and short hair, not only by clothing colour.
prompt_fields.composition: One entire figure on one disc, steep overhead three-quarter view, facing down-left or down-right. Head, hands and feet stay well inside the disc with a clear margin; the outer sixth of the disc radius stays bare base plate. Keep the head out of the upper-right rank corner and the upper-left interaction corner. No second figure, no mount, no companion, no ground clutter.
prompt_fields.palette: Warm mid-tone (tan to light-olive) skin, an undyed or muted earth-toned tunic (oat, sand or weathered brown), darker brown trousers and boots, natural brown or black hair. No bright saturated dye, no metallic sheen, no jewellery.
